entities.name: UniProt:P11633 NHP6B
observations: The 99-aa query sequence is an exact 100% full-length match to Saccharomyces cerevisiae non-histone chromosomal protein 6B (NHP6B).

Curated annotation describes NHP6B as a nuclear chromosomal DNA-binding protein that induces severe DNA bending and supports FACT-dependent chromatin reorganization; it also contributes to RNA polymerase III transcription fidelity.
Pfam detected HMG_box_2 (PF09011.17), residues 24–94, and HMG_box (PF00505.26), residues 27–95.

entities.name: NHP6B sequence properties
observations: For the unmodified 99-aa sequence, predicted mass is 11,475.836 Da, pI 9.896, and estimated charge at pH 7 is +8.52; sequence is strongly hydrophilic (GRAVY −1.3909).
